Question: Assalamualaikum Q1)A disable person who is unable to walk properly(has to walk with Clutches) is going for Umra,will it permissible for him to Sew elastic in the bottom part of the Ihram so that the Ihram doesnt fall of? Answer ID: 13667 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1081/914=D/1430) It is permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
